Substance Abuse in Garland

blocks.html: For many, there is a thin line between the recreational use of drugs and alcohol and addiction. When an individual is living with an addiction, they often cannot control their use. Maybe they have attempted to limit their use, or even attempted to stop before without success. You may find yourself thinking about your next use throughout the day and giving up important activities to use. You can experience consequences in your work, family relationships, friendships, and with your finances.

What to Look for in a Garland Drug Rehab Center

blocks.html:
If you are unable to control your use of drugs and alcohol, you may be at a point in your addiction where you should consider getting help. Inpatient rehab programs can provide you with detox and inpatient programs can provide you with invaluable support and knowledge.

When you begin to look at your inpatient treatment options in Garland, TX, there are a variety of characteristics that you will want to be mindful of. This includes the distance of the program from your home, and if it is in-network with your healthcare insurance. For inpatient treatment options, having some distance from the stressors at home can provide you with a sense of ease. It is important to find a program that can provide you with the level of care that you need. All of the addiction treatment options have specific criteria designed to help treatment providers narrow down which treatment option is ideal for you. If you are unsure which level of care you need, you can speak with your primary care physician or an intake specialist or treatment provider.

If you are living with other mental health concerns, you should be looking for treatment providers that offer dual-diagnosis programming. This can include care for individuals living with anxiety, depression, mood disorders, personality disorders, and trauma-related concerns. Additionally, treatment providers may offer specialized programming options for men, women, young adults, adolescents, veterans, professionals, and first responders.

Once you have those characteristics narrowed down, you can begin looking at the amenities that are offered. This can include private accommodations, sporting areas, access to natural areas, and alternative therapies. Alternative therapies can be a great opportunity to try new hobbies and interests that can support your recovery.

Dallas Detox Center Offers Addiction Treatment in Garland, TX

blocks.html:
Dallas Detox Center is the ideal inpatient rehab for the Garland area. We recognize the challenges that can arise in the beginning stages of your recovery, and work to support you through the ups and downs. Our detoxification program provides you with private accommodations while you experience the expected discomfort of the withdrawal process. Our medical staff will work with you around the clock to monitor you for known health complications, as well as to help you find comfort where possible. Your experience with withdrawal symptoms will be dependent on the substances you were abusing, as well as the amount and frequency.

If you choose to continue your inpatient treatment stay, Dallas Detox Center offers an inpatient rehab program that is designed to provide you with a solid foundation for your recovery. Our program includes educational sessions, group therapy sessions, and individual therapy sessions. Our holistic treatment approach takes your mental health into consideration and will include dual-diagnosis care if you are living with other mental health concerns.

Your experience at the beginning of your recovery will have a lasting impact on your sobriety. If you are ready to take a step forward in your recovery, we invite you to call (817) 904-2197 to speak with a Dallas Detox Center representative today.
